changelog: - **A chain of Converters under a run rule no longer loses resources when its target falls to almost nothing.** Where one Converter of a chain was given a run target of 0.000000001 or less, the Converters before it still ran and handed it their output; it took that, and its own inputs, and made nothing, and the group’s status read “met”. The whole chain now stands still at such a target, as a Converter on its own always did, and says it is stopped. Nothing changes for a target above 0.000000001, and none of the bundled examples is in that state as it ships. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 17).
